events.description: TalkBank describes not using contributor-implemented data-use agreements.

The 2022 commentary can reveal articulated design logic and the current pages can reveal implemented policy, but together they may not prove the complete temporal mechanism or rule out private alternatives.

inventory.summary: TalkBank describes rejecting contributor-implemented data-use agreements because of administrative burden and lack of NIH approval. Its IRB guidance presents multiple access options, with authorization, password protection, anonymization, consent, and additional restrictions for clinical data, communication disabilities, and video shaping the available strategies.
